items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: In the band was myself, Gene Wright on piano, Lee Gibson on drums, C. L. Burke and myself on trumpet.

ctx.x: Well at that time there were some very mixed feelings about the connotation "black", which is quite different than it is today.

That's about all I can remember about it except that in the latter part of our trip, the boss sent us on a tour of the other islands, playing theaters. We went to Maui, and the big island Honolulu, I mean the Hawaiian Island called Hilo *(the correct spelling) and we just broke it up on the stage. That Gene Wright, he could play all over the piano.
That must have been some experience for you.
